description: Custom schema for mono repo root package.json script descriptions.

clean.description: Runs all clean tasks in parallel: fixOwnWsImports, indexts, removeEmptyWsFiles, replaceBadDashChars.

clean:fixOwnWsImports.description: Fixes import statements where a path alias is used to reference its own workspace (can cause build problems due to circular references).

clean:indexts.description: Generate barrel export files at src/index.ts (runs script defined in each workspace package.json).

clean:removeEmptyWsFiles.description: Removes any files that have size 0 bytes for all workspaces.

clean:replaceBadDashChars.description: Replaces bad dash characters (em dash U+2014) with regular hyphens in all workspace files.

check.description: Runs all check tasks in parallel: check:knip.

check:knip.description: Runs knip to find unused exports, dependencies, and files.

build.description: Removes .dist directory and builds all workspaces.

insight.description: Runs all insight tasks sequentially: linesOfCode.

insight:linesOfCode.description: Counts lines of code across the monorepo by category.

docs.description: Generates TSDoc documentation for all library exports, then generates and writes the README.md file.

lint.description: Runs eslint on all workspaces (libs and apps) with caching. Ignores apps/playground and dist directories.

format-all:check.description:
Check formatting of all files in the monorepo using prettier.

Usage: `yarn format-all:check`

format:write.description: Formats files in the monorepo using prettier (writes changes).

format:check.description: Checks formatting of files in the monorepo using prettier (no changes written).

typecheck.description: Runs tsc typecheck on all workspaces (noEmit).

test.description:
Run vitest normally without coverage or watch mode.

Usage: `yarn test` or `yarn test <glob>`

test:watch.description: Run vitest in watch mode without coverage.

test-coverage.description:
Run vitest with coverage and bail on first failure.

Usage: `yarn test-coverage`

test-coverage-full.description: Run full coverage check via devkit, verifying coverage thresholds.

test-coverage:open.description: Open the coverage index html file with OS default app.

precommit:fix.description: Runs sequential fix tasks: clean, lint-fix, format:write.

precommit:check.description: Runs parallel check tasks: typecheck, check.

precommit:build.description: Runs sequential build tasks: build, test-coverage-full, docs.

precommit.description: Runs full pre-commit pipeline: install, precommit:fix, test-coverage, precommit:check, precommit:build.

publish:devkit.description: Build and publish the devkit package to npm.

publish:linkedin-resume.description: Build and publish the linkedin-resume package to npm.

foreach.description:
Run a command for each workspace in parallel (excludes root).

Usage: `yarn foreach run <command>`
